sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

content.text: Generate an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 600" width="600" height="600">
  <defs>
    <g id="bottle">
      <rect x="-7" y="-12" width="14" height="30" rx="4" fill="#3a9d5d" stroke="#1f5c35" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="-3" y="-26" width="6" height="16" fill="#3a9d5d" stroke="#1f5c35" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect width="600" height="600" fill="#fdf3dc"/>

    <!-- wheel -->
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 300 490" to="360 300 490" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle cx="300" cy="490" r="48" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="8"/>
      <circle cx="300" cy="490" r="42" fill="none" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
      <g stroke="#888" stroke-width="2">
        <line x1="258" y1="490" x2="342" y2="490"/>
        <line x1="300" y1="448" x2="300" y2="532"/>
        <line x1="270" y1="460" x2="330" y2="520"/>
        <line x1="330" y1="460" x2="270" y2="520"/>
      </g>

      <line x1="282" y1="490" x2="318" y2="490" stroke="#444" stroke-width="5"/>

    <circle cx="300" cy="490" r="6" fill="#444"/>

    <path d="M272 388 Q300 376 328 388 L324 396 L276 396 Z" fill="#222"/>

        <animate attributeName="d" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"
          values="M290 385 L335 430 L318 490;M290 385 L325 445 L300 508;M290 385 L310 432 L282 490;M290 385 L330 420 L300 472;M290 385 L335 430 L318 490"/>
      </path>
      <path stroke="#57483a">
        <animate attributeName="d" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"
          values="M290 385 L310 432 L282 490;M290 385 L330 420 L300 472;M290 385 L335 430 L318 490;M290 385 L325 445 L300 508;M290 385 L310 432 L282 490"/>
      </path>
    </g>

    <!-- tail -->
    <path d="M262 350 Q180 330 150 400 Q140 440 175 430 Q200 380 268 380 Z" fill="#57483a">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-6 262 365;8 262 365;-6 262 365" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </path>

    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="335" rx="48" ry="62" fill="#8a7560"/>
    <!-- anteater chest stripe -->
    <path d="M262 300 Q300 330 345 300 L340 322 Q300 352 266 322 Z" fill="#2b241d"/>
    <path d="M262 298 Q300 328 345 298" fill="none" stroke="#f0e6d2" stroke-width="4"/>

    <!-- head with long snout -->
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-5 315 270;4 315 270;-5 315 270" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M290 285 Q290 245 325 245 Q360 248 440 285 Q448 292 438 296 Q370 292 335 298 Q300 300 290 285 Z" fill="#8a7560" stroke="#57483a" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="441" cy="290" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#2b241d"/>
      <path d="M440 294 Q470 300 480 285" fill="none" stroke="#e0607a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round">
        <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" values="M440 294 Q470 300 480 285;M440 294 Q465 305 478 310;M440 294 Q470 300 480 285"/>
      </path>
      <circle cx="338" cy="266" r="5" fill="#111"/>
      <circle cx="340" cy="264" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/>
      <ellipse cx="302" cy="248" rx="9" ry="13" fill="#57483a" transform="rotate(-20 302 248)"/>
    </g>

    <!-- arms: hands bob to throw/catch -->
    <g stroke="#6b5a48" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
      <path>
        <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" values="M270 320 Q225 335 215 300;M270 320 Q225 325 215 280;M270 320 Q225 335 215 300"/>
      </path>
      <path>
        <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.8s" begin="-0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" values="M330 320 Q375 345 390 300;M330 320 Q375 335 390 280;M330 320 Q375 345 390 300"/>
      </path>
    </g>

    <!-- juggled bottles: cascade arcs -->
    <g>
      <g>
        <animateMotion dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M215 285 Q290 -40 390 285 Q300 -40 215 285"/>
        <use href="#bottle"><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></use>
      </g>
      <g>
        <animateMotion dur="2.4s" begin="-0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M215 285 Q290 -40 390 285 Q300 -40 215 285"/>
        <use href="#bottle"><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></use>
      </g>
      <g>
        <animateMotion dur="2.4s" begin="-1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M215 285 Q290 -40 390 285 Q300 -40 215 285"/>
        <use href="#bottle"><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></use>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>

content.text:
Created `anteater-unicycle.svg` in the working directory. I haven't rendered it, so the look and timing are unchecked.

It uses SMIL animation only (no scripts), so open it in a browser to see it move:

- **Unicycle:** the wheel, spokes and pedals spin while the legs pedal in time with the cranks.
- **Anteater:** it has a long snout with a flicking tongue, a chest stripe and a wagging bushy tail, and the whole rider rocks gently for balance.
- **Juggling:** three green bottles tumble through arcs between the two hands, which bob as they throw and catch.
